title: PLC Studio version profile
description: Everything that differs between TIA Portal versions or CPU families, as data. Skeleton: the sections are filled from M2 on.

id.description: Profile id, the same as the profile's folder name.

tiaVersion.description: The TIA Portal version this profile describes.

extends.description: Id of the profile this one builds on; it then lists only differences. Null for a base profile.

instructions.description: System instructions available in this version.

systemTypes.description: System data types such as timer and counter instance types.

typeRules.description: Implicit conversions with the IEC check on and off, literal forms, limits per data type.

syntaxFeatures.description: Language constructs, pragmas and attributes accepted in SCL, external sources and SIMATIC SD documents.

sdFormat.description: SIMATIC SD keywords, attribute spellings and resource-file layout.

failsafe.description: Fail-safe catalog: permitted F-instructions, data types and access rules.

cpuFamilies.description: Differences between S7-1200 and S7-1500, including memory and addressing limits.

verification.description: Whether a corpus case compiled in TIA proves this entry. Unverified entries downgrade related diagnostics to warnings.

cases.description: Corpus case ids that use the entry.

type.description: Data type, or a list of types the parameter accepts.

minFirmware.description: Lowest firmware per CPU family, where it matters.

helpUrl.description: Siemens' online-help page for the instruction (https).
